claims.claim: Title/subtitle: 2025-26 Electoral Boundaries Commission
claims.found: Final report of the 2025-26 Commission

claims.claim: Commission finished its work on March 23, 2026
claims.found: Dated at the City of Edmonton this 23rd day of March 2026
claims.note: Report was tabled by the Speaker March 26 (votes_proceedings_2026-04-21 p.2); 'finished' = signed March 23.

claims.claim: could not agree; three commissioners signed one map, the other two signed a different one
claims.found: Majority signed by Miller, Clark, Samson; minority report signed by Evans and Martin (evidence/README.md)

claims.claim: The other two, the two the government nominated (Assembly notice March 28, 2025)
claims.found: Evans KC and Dr. Martin 'Nominated by the President of Executive Council'; Clark and Samson 'Nominated by the Leader of His Majesty's Loyal Opposition'
claims.note: Notice date March 28, 2025 matches evidence/README.md.

claims.claim: Both maps meet the Act's numeric rules
claims.found: Each map: 86 COMPLIANT within +/-25% band; 3 outside band classed S15_JUSTIFIED (Pass); none non-compliant
claims.note: Numeric compliance relies on s.15(2) exceptions for 3 divisions on each map.

claims.claim: majority argued the minority's map would likely fail a Charter challenge
claims.found: 'the minority maps likely violate s. 3 of the Charter'; 'likely to offend s. 3 of the Charter'

claims.claim: Three weeks later, on April 16, the government brought in Government Motion 37
claims.found: Motion 37 introduced April 16, 2026 (floor debate; CBC April 16). March 23 to April 16 = 24 days (about 3.4 weeks)
claims.note: The primary Hansard 2026-04-16 (evidence/web) is two-column and my text search did not find the formal introduction text; the date rests on the audit's own findings file and academic report. 'Three weeks' is rounded down from 3.4.

claims.claim: Motion 37 passed April 21
claims.found: Motion 37 agreed to; For 44, Against 36

claims.claim: set both maps aside and handed the job to a committee of six MLAs, most from the UCP
claims.found: 'Committee Members (6)': four UCP, two NDP (per README)

claims.claim: An independent advisory panel working for that committee delivered a new map on October 22
claims.found: 'The Independent Advisory Panel provided its report to the Committee on October 22, 2026'
claims.note: That the report contains a new map (91 seats) is from the academic report l.244 / IAP report.

claims.claim: On October 28 the committee voted 3-2 to end its review, adding no observations of its own
claims.found: Motion to 'conclude its review'; Totals For 3 (de Jonge, Rowswell, Wiebe), Against 2 (Gray, Ganley); carried
claims.note: No-observations: Gray at CEB-73 per evidence/README.md; my text search did not re-find it because of line breaks.

claims.claim: The panel's report was due before the Assembly by November 2, 2026
claims.found: Committee 'must submit the report to the Legislative Assembly no later than November 2, 2026'; IAP report confidential until tabled on or before Nov 2
claims.note: Strictly the committee must submit by Nov 2; panel report went to the committee by Oct 22. Sentence compresses this.

claims.claim: Five structural tests, written down on April 24, 2026, after a first measurement of both maps on provisional boundaries, dated in this repository
